The original A-page summary asserts transfer only under uniform operator/norm comparisons. With the weighted G_m norm of ex-mesh-grid-norm-hides-common-space-instability, set Q_m=I and U=I, retaining truncation P_m and inclusion R_m. Then P_m R_m=I, the kernel is invariant and S_m=R_m P_m+(I-R_m P_m)=I. Both power families have norm one, while ||P_m||>=m and ||R_m e_(m-1)||/||e_(m-1)||=1/m, so no uniform lower reconstruction bound exists. The original necessary-condition assertion is false.
